initial_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production 2D tactical fantasy game sprite sheet using the attached image ONLY as character identity, costume and rifle reference. A rugged adult male northern hunter: dark hair and short beard, dark blue leather armor, heavy charcoal wolf-fur shoulder cloak, boots, holds the SAME long modern-looking rifle as reference. FULL BODY visible including feet and barrel in EVERY frame. One consistent character, fixed scale, realistic hand-painted fantasy sprite aesthetic, crisp readable silhouette appropriate to a Heroes-like turn-based battlefield, orthographic side-on three-quarter camera, faces RIGHT. EXACTLY 6 equal columns by 5 equal rows = 30 separate animation frames; every cell has the same dimensions and 15 percent transparent padding, no overlap between cells. The entire canvas should be 6:5 aspect ratio. Row 1: 6 subtle idle breathing poses, a seamless loop. Row 2: 6 distinct walk cycle phases, feet alternate planting, character stays at same center within each cell, seamless loop. Row 3: 6 sequential rifle attack poses: raise weapon, aim, fire with small bright muzzle flash, recoil, recover, lower into ready stance. Row 4: 6 sequential getting-hit poses: brace, flinch back, react, recoil settles, recover, ready again; NO blood. Row 5: 6 sequential death poses: stagger, knees buckle, fall, descend, land, final motionless body lying on ground; final frame fully visible and not clipped. Use identical face, clothing, weapon, orientation, and ground baseline in all rows. Fixed camera, no zoom or camera movement. Isolated figures on actual transparent background, no backdrop, no ground plane or shadows extending to adjacent cells, no text, labels, row numbers, borders or visible grid. Need distinct drawn body poses, NOT copies of one still image translated or rotated.
revision_prompt: Precisely repack and clean up the attached sprite animation sheet, preserving the same hunter design and all 30 distinct action poses. PRODUCTION ATLAS: exactly SIX columns and FIVE rows, all square cells, canvas aspect ratio 6:5. Each character MUST be smaller within its own square: occupy at most 70 percent of cell width and 80 percent of cell height. Leave at least 12 percent COMPLETELY EMPTY transparent gutter on ALL FOUR SIDES of EACH cell; in particular all rifle barrels, muzzle flash, fur cloaks and fallen bodies must stay away from the cell borders and outer canvas borders. Center each frame in its cell on a consistent ground baseline (standing feet at 85 percent cell height); dead bodies rest on that same baseline. Do not let ANY neighboring frame pixels enter another cell. Actual transparent alpha=0 background, no tiny opaque speckles, no shadows on ground, no dust, no gridlines or text. Maintain the exact same fully clothed adult northern rifle hunter identity and realistic painted tactical game style. Row 1 idle six distinct subtle breathing phases; row 2 six distinct alternating-foot walk phases; row 3 six rifle attack phases including a single small muzzle flash; row 4 six flinch/recovery phases; row 5 six death/falling phases finishing flat and still. No blood. One sprite per cell, fixed scale, side-on three-quarter facing right in every frame. Do not crop any feet, heads, rifle barrels or bodies.
